editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: FxPro is a legitimate, FCA-regulated NDD broker operating since 2006 with four regulatory licences across FCA, CySEC, FSCA, and SCB. It scores 7.8/10 from NAFT in 2026 — strong on execution quality, platform diversity, and ECN pricing via Raw+. The triple-platform offering of MT4, MT5, and cTrader gives traders genuine choice. Raw+ spreads from 0.0 pips with $7 commission per lot are competitive with Pepperstone and IC Markets. The 75% retail loss rate is above average. FxPro works for the execution-focused trader who values speed, platform choice, and raw pricing over educational content or social trading features.
